主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. issued a press release on March 31, 2015, announcing its financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2014. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The report is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes the signature of Eric Skolnik, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, dated March 31, 2015.
